mentions.name: Maxxmod
mentions.description: This Chrome extension improves the YouTube experience by removing distractions such as Shorts and cluttered search results, and adds tools and shortcuts including a volume booster, screenshot tool, quick access to Picture-in-Picture, and playback speed controls. It also includes an option to stop comment GIFs from autoplaying, playing them on demand instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: A month and half ago launched Maxxmod, a Chrome extension that improves the YouTube experience by removing distractions (hiding Shorts and cleaning up search results) and adding new tools and shortcuts (volume booster, screenshot tool, quick access to Picture-in-Picture and playback speed controls). I’ve been adding features since then.
mentions.author: neonglow
